response.original_title: [(@Instant~FAQ#)] How do I add multiple rooms on Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: To add multiple rooms to a Carnival Cruise booking, contact ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (U.S. and Canada) or ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎︎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK) Carnival Cruise or your travel agent and provide your existing reservation number. Explain how many additional staterooms you need and provide the guests’ details. Availability, cabin categories, and pricing may vary. For assistance, call ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (U.S. and Canada) or ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎︎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK) in the U.S. and Canada. A representative can help locate available rooms and arrange the additional reservations.
